chatInputFormCodingModeButton.tooltip: An agentic coding tool for your project folder
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.description: An agentic coding tool that edits files, runs commands, and commits changes in the folder you choose.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.checkingLocalModel: Checking whether your on-device model can run Code…
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.pickLocalModel: Pick an on-device model first: open the model list and choose one marked On-Device.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.localModelCantEdit: {model} can’t change files or run commands, so Code can’t use it.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.localModelUnknown: We couldn’t confirm {model} can change files or run commands, so Code may not work with it.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.tryToolCapableModel: Try a model that can, such as Qwen 3, Llama 3.2 or Phi-4 Mini.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.firstRunSlow: First run can take a few minutes while the model loads.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.modelUnavailable: isn’t available for Code — turns will fail. Pick a different model in the top-left.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.skillsSyncFailed: Skills couldn’t be synced — Code will run without them.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.sandboxMissing: Code needs bubblewrap (bwrap). Install it with your package manager, then reopen the app.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.permissionModeAutoHint: Code changes files and runs commands without asking. Use it only in folders you trust.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.permissionModeAutoCoworkHint: With Cowork on, it also acts on your screen without asking.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.permissionModeManualHint: Code checks with you before it changes files or runs commands.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.permissionModeSaveFailed: The approval setting could not be saved. Code still uses the previous setting.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.agentSignedOutCodex: Not signed in — sign in to Codex in the ChatGPT app.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.agentSignedOutClaude: Not signed in — run claude in a terminal.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.connectHint: In the desktop app, open Code and enable Phone access, then enter its address and password here.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.desktopUnreachable: Your computer isn't reachable — is the desktop app running on the same network?
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.localNetworkHint: If your phone asks to find devices on your local network, tap Allow.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.localNetworkDenied: Local Network access is off for ibl.ai, so Code can’t reach your computer. Turn it on in Settings, then come back here.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.phoneAccessHint: On your phone, open Code and enter this address and password.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.phoneAccessOffHint: Let your phone run Code on this computer.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied — enter the address manually.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.notAPairingCode: That QR code isn't a Code pairing code.
chatInputFormCodingModeButton.scanHint: Point your camera at the pairing QR code shown on your computer.
